verdict.rationale: PostHog is open-source with a documented MIT-licensed self-host option, giving users the ability to run and own their entire stack, and it exposes data via SQL/HogQL, a REST API, and data-warehouse sync so events, persons, and sessions can be queried or piped out to external systems. However, there's no explicit documented 'export everything to open formats and leave' workflow (e.g., a one-click full account export or documented migration path) in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: a dedicated bulk/GDPR-style data export feature, documented open-format (CSV/Parquet) export tooling, and independent confirmation that self-hosted migration actually preserves all historical data without vendor lock-in.
